analysis_refs.heading: C02. General books and ebooks
analysis_refs.text:
**India route.** Start with state-library and language-academy institution lists,
then inspect the official digital catalogs. [Project Madurai](https://www.projectmadurai.org/)
is a concrete Tamil literature lead with a linked works list and text-format
information. Its reading/distribution statements do not by themselves establish
permission for the app's proposed metadata harvest. Investigate Hindi and other
regional literary catalogs through their actual operators rather than copying
anonymous “free PDF” lists.

analysis_refs.heading: Evidence boundaries and next handoff
analysis_refs.text:
Documentation opens succeeded for IBBY, Parag, Book Dash, Gutenberg, OTL, DOAB,
Project Madurai, LibriVox, DAISY and NLS during this planning review. The research
tool returned HTTP 402 for StoryWeaver's open-content page, 502 for NCERT's
textbook page and 403 for DPLA's API page. Sugamya redirected to its current domain
but exposed no readable content to the tool. These observations establish neither
payment requirements nor source-wide outages. No credentials, source accounts,
outreach, bulk harvests or live query qualification probes were performed.

analysis_refs.heading: Verification and preserved failures
analysis_refs.text:
- 50 current passing examples in the five source-specific JSONL files. Thoth queries verify publisher identity and title relevance; local catalogs distinguish title queries from upstream keyword search.
- Sugamya returned no result table for two full-title strings. Shorter relevant keywords succeeded; both failed requests remain saved.
- OpenStax direct subject reload produced an empty app shell. Normal public-link navigation plus a wait for rendered book cards succeeds; failed browser observations remain saved.
- Project Madurai's first 558 KB catalog exceeded the documentation sampler’s 512 KB cap. A bounded metadata-only capture completed; the parser handles the published omitted table-cell close and retains malformed format links without repairing/fetching them.
- 267 research tests pass, including publisher mismatch, changed/empty/challenge result shapes, Unicode catalog lookup, edition preservation, browser-output hash rejection and SWAYAM exclusion. Capture → index → audit and registry validation pass; missing/mismatched evidence hashes remain errors.
